content.comment_body: Hello, I'm using a [product_name] to control some values on a [product_name] project, which I view through my browser. After editing the [product_name] project, I need to re-download it to the [product_name]. However, this process currently takes about 10 minutes, with a transfer speed of roughly 5kb/s. Is this typical? Am I missing something that could make it faster?
As far as I know, there isn't a way to achieve a higher transfer speed.
Hi, I’ve encountered the same issue as described. My workaround was to switch to a faster memory card, specifically one rated as Class 10.
Ten minutes is quite lengthy. I suggest trying the 'deploy to SD card' option, as it may be significantly quicker than transferring online.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report very slow speeds, around 5kb/s, when moving a [product_name] project from the editor to the [product_name] device, resulting in download times of up to 10 minutes. This affects workflow efficiency and raises concerns. Community advice focuses on hardware changes, like upgrading to faster storage cards or using alternative deployment methods, since no software-based solution currently addresses the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect much quicker project transfer speeds to their devices and hope for an optimized workflow without excessive waiting periods.
